# Den Ree

Musician, livecoder, A/V performer — exploring the creative potentials of code.

## Summary

Den Ree is the personal site of a musician, livecoder, and A/V performer based in Rotterdam. He performs live-coded electronic music with real-time visuals (algo-DJ sets), most notably the Machine Music project with Nikilia, developed during a residency at V2_ Lab for the Unstable Media. The site keeps a performance log of upcoming and past shows (algoraves, museum programmes, livecoding events). He also builds software for artists and creators, is part of NDA/studio, a creative technology studio (https://www.nda.studio), and writes a journal on livecoding, creative coding, and working with AI. Target audience: people interested in livecoding, electronic music, A/V performance, creative tech, and bookings.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://denree.nl/): Horizontal timeline of activity — performances, releases, software, journal notes
- [Music](https://denree.nl/music): Machine Music project and the full performance log — upcoming and past shows
- [Software](https://denree.nl/software): Software for artists — Tapelet, Content Office — and mobile development collaborations
- [About](https://denree.nl/about): Bio, NDA/studio, contact details, and journal notes
- [Journal](https://denree.nl/journal): Thoughts on livecoding music, creative coding, staying creative

## Music

- Machine Music: A/V performance with live-coded music and real-time visuals, in collaboration with Nikilia; developed at V2_ Lab for the Unstable Media
- Performance log: upcoming and past shows at https://denree.nl/music — including ZONE XP Algorave at Le Sucre (Grame Festival, Lyon, 6 Nov 2026), NDA/ Machine Music live VJ set at Festival Broncode, the opening of the KB national library exhibition “Broncode: boeken in het AI-tijdperk” (Den Haag, 29 Oct 2026), ADE Live Coding Sessions Algorave at DOKA (Amsterdam, 21 Oct 2026), GRAW performance / installation at De Achtertuin (Rotterdam, 18 Sep 2026) — premiere of BOIS, a live set with Rik Mertens (https://soundcloud.com/den-ree/bois), Beeld & Geluid Open Culture Tech Residency (Hilversum), EXPORT × Boijmans: Night Pioneers (Pixel Pioneers programme, Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen), Algorave Amsterdam (Vondelbunker), V2_ Live: “Mirage”, and more
- Listen: https://soundcloud.com/den-ree/machine-music-by-den-ree-x-nikilia

## Journal

- [Finding Algoraves](https://denree.nl/journal/finding-algoraves): On discovering the algorave scene and what changes when music and visuals are performed live with code.
- [Wearing the Suit](https://denree.nl/journal/wearing-the-suit): Building with blanche vs getting blanche to build for you — wear the mechanic's suit, not the Iron Legion.

## Software for artists

- Tapelet: Multitrack Recorder — Mac app for capturing performances and ideas, now on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/tapelet-multitrack-recorder/id6762547842?mt=12
- Content Office: Instagram planner app for creators
- NDA/studio: creative technology studio — https://www.nda.studio
- Collaborations: mobile development (iOS and cross-platform) for artists, studios, and founders — prototypes to App Store releases
